title: Open Graph Preview
description: Preview how your link looks when shared — rendered Facebook, X and LinkedIn cards plus the exact meta tags to paste.
howto: Enter your page title, description and image URL.
See the link card rendered as Facebook, X and LinkedIn would show it.
Copy the generated og: and twitter: meta tags into your page head.

faqs.a: Meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image…) that tell social platforms what title, description and image to show when your link is shared.

faqs.q: Why is my image not showing in the preview?
faqs.a: The image URL must be absolute (https://…) and publicly reachable. Hotlink-protected or relative URLs will not render here or on real platforms.

faqs.q: How big should the og:image be?
faqs.a: 1200 × 630 px (1.91:1) is the safe standard — it fills Facebook and LinkedIn cards without cropping.
